name: smwgraphics-the-legend-of-zelda-link-s-awakening-grassland
title: The Legend Of Zelda: Link's Awakening - Grassland
description:
A grassland tileset from The Legend of Zelda: Link's Awakening DX. Uses an unusual pseudo 3D perspective and can be a good fit for mountain levels, as well.

Anorakun's edit: Cleaned GFX space, fixed some inaccuracies, made a better map 16, added palette and palmask files , along with a new sample level.

Colors should be easy to edit, which is why I didn't include the original palette.
